title: PIRs
markdown:
The Priority Intel Requirement (PIR) is prepared to evaluate the incident response effectiveness. PIRs are initiated as part of the Incident Response process and can help an incident manager in identifying and correcting weaknesses within the organization's security posture. This can also help you to identify whether all the corrective Actions and Enhancements are in place for preventing future attacks.

This section describes how to use the API endpoints to manage the PIRs.
